user.title: Set up Panasonic AC Local
user.description: Native local UDP control for supported Panasonic India MirAIe ACs. Your AC must already be paired with MirAIe.

menu_options.account: Get local keys using a Panasonic MirAIe account
menu_options.manual: Enter existing local keys (no account needed)
menu_options.bridge: Connect an existing local HTTP bridge (advanced)

account.title: Panasonic MirAIe account
account.description: Sign in once to obtain the device’s local encryption keys. Your password and account tokens are not saved. Runtime control uses your LAN only. Use your MirAIe email or mobile number, including country code if required.

manual.title: Existing local keys
manual.description: Use this if you already have the device ID, AES-256 key (64 hexadecimal characters) and IV (32 hexadecimal characters). These secrets are stored in the HA config entry.

network.title: AC local network
network.description: Enter the AC address from your router and leave Automatic selected. Home Assistant must receive the AC replies on its own network connection. Separate IoT networks may need VLAN setup; see the network guide. Verification briefly changes the target by 1°C, then restores it without changing power.

firewall.title: Local control verified — optional cloud isolation
firewall.description: A local temperature change and restoration succeeded. You can now block this AC’s internet/WAN access on your firewall, for IPv4 and IPv6. Keep Wi-Fi/LAN enabled, DHCP/DNS as needed, UDP 5001 to the AC, and UDP 5002 broadcast replies. Do not pause or disconnect the device. Click Submit after applying the block, or skip the block and finish; local control is tested again before setup completes. This integration does not change firewall rules or verify that WAN is blocked.

bridge.title: Existing local bridge
bridge.description: Compatibility mode for an already configured native UDP HTTP bridge. The bridge must report working local UDP control. Account setup and the native write verification are not performed in this compatibility mode.

discover.title: Finding and checking your AC
discover.description: Discovering the AC on your LAN, then testing a temperature change and restoration. Power is unchanged. If discovery is blocked by VLAN boundaries, network options will appear automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the account service or local bridge.
error.no_devices: No ACs were found in this MirAIe account.
error.no_local_key: This device does not expose a usable local control key.
error.invalid_key: Check the device ID, 64-character key and 32-character IV.
error.local_unreachable: Local read/write verification failed. Check the AC address, keys, and whether AC broadcasts reach Home Assistant. See the network guide for separate IoT networks. Do not block WAN until local verification succeeds.

progress.local_setup: Finding the AC and verifying local control…
